m: प्रति—शाखा f. a side branch, s˚ shoot (pl. all the schools of the Veda, BhP.)
प्रति—शाखा—नाडी f. a branch vein, PraśnUp.
प्रति—शाखम् ind. for every branch or school (of the Veda), Bādar., Sch.
प्रति—शाख-वत् See -शाखा.
प्रति—शा˚ख—वत् mfn. having anything as side branches, MBh.
प्रति-˚शान्त mfn. extinguished, allayed
प्रति-˚शान्त—कोप mfn. one whose anger is past, ib.
प्रति-˚शाप m. a curse in return, retorted imprecation, MBh.; Kād.; Pur.
a: प्रतिशापः — A curse for curse, a curse in return.

2. प्रति-शासन (for 1. See p. 663, col. 2) n. giving orders, commissioning, sending a servant on a message, L.
a: प्रतिशासनं — 1 Giving orders, sending on an errand, ordering. --2 Ordering or despatching an inferior after calling him to attend. --3 Counter-manding. --4 A rival command or authority; अप्रतिशासनं जगत् R. 8. 27 ‘completely under the sway of one ruler’.

k.v: प्रेषणं यत्समाहूय तत्र स्यात्प्रतिशासनम्. स संस्तावः क्रतुषु या स्तुतिभूमिर्द्विजन्मनाम्.।

m: प्रति-˚शास्ति f. id., MW.
a: प्रतिशास्तिः — f. Sending on an errand.

m: प्रति-√ शॄ P. -शृणाति, to break off or in pieces, RV.; TS.; TBr.
प्रति-√ शी (only pf. -शिश्ये and fut. -शेष्यामि), to lie or press against i.e. urge, importune, MBh.
प्रति-˚शीन and प्रति-˚शीन-वत् (Kāś.; ib.), mfn. melted, fluid, dropping.
प्रति-शीत (Pāṇ. vi, 1, 25, Sch.) mfn. melted, fluid, dropping.
प्रति-˚शीवन् mf(अरी)n. serving as a couch or resting-place, AV.; TS.
प्रति-शौचम् ind. at each purification, Baudh.
प्रति-√ शंस् P. -शंसति to call or shout to, praise, ŚBr. (cf. अ-प्रतिशंसत् and ˚शस्त).
प्रति-√ शङ्क् Ā. -शङ्कते, to be doubtful or anxious, hesitate, MBh.; to trouble one's self about, care for (acc.), BhP.
प्रति-˚शङ्का f. (ifc.) doubt, supposition, Kām.
constant fear or doubt, W.
प्रति-˚शङ्कनीय mfn. to be doubted about or feared, W.
प्रति—शशिन् m. a mock moon, paraselene, Var.

प्रति—शब्द—वत् mfn. re-echoing, resounding, Kathās.
प्रति-शक् (only pf. -शेकुः), to keep one's ground against, be a match for (acc.), MBh. : Desid. -शिक्षति, to allure, invite, RV.
प्रति-√ शम् Caus. -शामयति (ind.p. -शाम्य, or -शामयित्वा or -शमय्य), to reestablish, restore, put to rights, Vajracch.; Divyāv.
प्रति-˚शम m. (ifc.) deliverance from, cessation of MBh.
प्रति-√ शप् P. -शपति, to curse in return (with acc. or gen.), R.; BhP.
प्रति—शरासन n. an adversary's bow, Vās.
प्रति—शरीरम् ind. concerning one's own body or person, Pat.
प्रति-˚शर m. breaking, going in pieces (अ-प्रतिश्˚), AitBr.
प्रति—शरण n. (for 2. See under प्रति-√ शॄ) confidence in (ifc.), Divyāv.
1. 2. प्रति-शरण See p. 663 and प्रति-√ शॄ.
2. प्रति-˚शरण n. (for 1. see p. 663, col. 2) breaking off, blunting (a point or edge), TBr., Sch.
प्रति—शरण—भूत mfn. resorted to (acc.), ib. (cf. -सरण under प्रति-√ सृ).
प्रति—शत्रु (प्रति-), m. an adversary, opponent, enemy, AV.; Kuval., Sch.

a: प्रतिशयनं — The act of lying down without food before a deity to secure some desired object.

m: प्रति-˚शयित mfn. pressing, importuning, importuned, Kād.; Hcar.
प्रति-˚शयित n. the act of importuning, molestation, Kād.
a: प्रतिशयित — a. One who lies down without food before a deity to secure his desired object; अनया च किलास्मै प्रतिशयिताय स्वप्ने समादिष्टं Dk. 122.

m: प्रति—शृङ्गेण ind. horn by h˚, Hcat.
प्रति-√ शिक्ष् See प्रति-√ शक्.
प्रति—शिल्प n. a counter-Śilpa, ŚāṅkhŚr.

m: प्रति-˚शिष्ट mfn. sent on a message, despatched, Śiś.
refused, L.
celebrated, famous, W.
a: प्रतिशिष्ट — p. p. 1 Ordered, sent; Śi. 16. 1. --2 Dismissed, rejected. --3 Famous, celebrated.

m: प्रति—शिष्य m. under-disciple (?), Divyāv.
प्रति—श्लोक m. a counter Śloka, Siṃhās.; L.
प्रति—श्लोकम् ind. at every Śl˚, BhP.
प्रति-शोभित mfn. (√ शुभ्, Caus.) beautified with (instr.), Hariv. (v.l. for परि-श्˚).
प्रति-श्रम m. (√ श्रम्) toil, trouble, Divyāv.
प्रति-˚श्र˚वान्ते ind. after the expiration of a promise i.e. the lapse of a promised period, R.

a: प्रतिश्रवः — 1 Assent, agreement, promise. --2 An echo.

v: na॰ prati + Sru--BAve lyuw । 1 aNgIkAre । pratigataH SravaRaM karRam atyA॰ sa॰ । 2 SravaRAnugate tri॰ asya tatpuruze aMSvA॰ antodAttatA pratigataM SravaRaM yena prA॰ va॰ । tu na ।

answering, Gaut.
assenting to, agreeing, promising, Mn. ii, 195 (others ‘hearkening’ or ‘answering’), MBh. (-पूर्व mfn. promised, assured), Pāṇ. viii, 2, 99 (Kāś., ‘hearkening’)
(prob.) a partic. part of the ear, ṢaḍvBr.
a: प्रतिश्रवणं — 1 Listening to; Ms. 2. 195. --2 Promising, assenting; agreeing. --3 A promise. --4 Maintaining.

m: प्रति-˚श्रवण—पूर्व mfn., promised, assured

v: pu॰ pratiSrIyate prati + Sri--ADAre ac । 1 yajYagfhe jawA॰ 2 saBAyAM 3 ASaye ca medi॰ 4 gfhe hemaca॰ ।

a place of refuge, shelter, asylum, house, dwelling, Mn.; MBh. &c.
a receptacle, recipient (त्वं तस्य प्रतिश्रयः, ‘you know all this’), MBh.
a jaina-monastery, HPariś.
an almshouse, a place where food &c. is given away, L.
a place of sacrifice, L.
an assembly, L.
a: प्रतिश्रयः — 1 A shelter, asylum. --2 A house, dwelling, residence; Y. 1. 210; Ms. 10. 51. --3 An asembly. --4 A sacrificial hall. --5 Help, assistance. --6 A promise. --7 A receptacle.

m: प्रति-˚श्रित n. a place of refuge, MBh.

प्रति-˚श्रोतस् w.r. for ˚स्रोतस्.
प्रति-˚श्रोतृ mfn. one who promises or assents, MW.

a promise, assurance, Siṃhās.
a: प्रतिश्रुत्, प्रतिश्रुतिः — f. 1 A promise. --2 An echo, reverberation; R. 13. 40; 16. 31; Śi. 17. 42.

promised (also in marriage), assented, agreed, accepted (˚ते, ‘the promise having been made’), GṛS.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
echoing, resounding, R.

प्रति-˚श्रुत n. a promise, engagement (see above).

a promise, assent, Vait.
= next, Śiś.
प्रति-˚श्रुत्का f. an echo, reverberation, VS.; ChUp.
प्रति-√ शुच् P. -शोचति, to burn towards or against (acc.), MaitrS.
प्रति—शुक्र-बुध (ibc.), towards the planets Venus or Mercury, Var.
प्रति—शुक्रम् (perhaps two words) ind. towards the planet Venus, R.

a: प्रतिश्या, प्रतिश्यानं, प्रतिश्यायः — A catarrh or cold.

s: puM, (pratikzaRaM SyAyate iti । prati + SyE + “SyAdvaDAsrusaMmvratIReti .” 3 । 1 । 141 । iti RaH .) pInasarogaH । ityamaraH । 2 । 6 । 51 ॥ (yaTA, suSrute sUtrasTAne 45 aDyAye । “pArSvaSUle pratiSyAye vAtaroge galagrahe ॥” asya sakAraRalakzaRaM samprAptiSca yaTA, -- “sanDAraRAjIrRarajo'tiBAzyakroDarttuvEzamyaSiro'BitApEH । prajAgarAtisvapanAmbuSItEravaSyayA mETunavAzpaDUmEH ॥ saMstyAnadoze Sirasi pravfdDo vAyuH pratiSyAyamudIrayettu । GrARArttitodEH SvayaTurjalABaH srAvo'nilAt sasvanamUrdDvarogaH ॥ nAsAgrapAkajvaravaktraSozatfzRozRapItasravaRAni pittAt । kAsArucisrAvanayanaprasekAH kaPAdguruH srotasi cApi kaRqUH ॥ sarvvARi rUpARi tu sannipAtAt syuH pInase tIvraruje'tiduHKe । sarvvo'tivfdDo'hitaBojanAttu duzwapratiSyAya upekzitaH syAt ॥” iti carake cikitsAsTAne zaqviMSe'DyAye ॥)
v: pu॰ prati + SyE--karaRe GaY । pInase rogaBede tallakzaRAdi suSrutoktaM yaTA “aTAtaH pratiSyAyapratizeDe vyAKyAsyAmaH । nArIprasaNgaH Siraso'BitApo DUmo rajaH SItamatipratApaH । sanDAraRaM mUtrapurIzayoSca sadyaH pratiSyAyanidAnamuktam । cayaNgatA mUrdDvani mArutAdayaH pfTaksamastASca taTEva SoRitam । prakopyamAnA viviDEH prakopaRErnfRAM pratiSyAyakarA Bavanti hi । SirogurutvaM kzavaToH pravarttanaM taTANgamardaH parihfzwaromatA । upadravAScApyapare pfTagviDA nfRAM pratiSyAyapuraHsarAH smftAH । AnadDA pihitA nAsA tanusrAvapravarttinI । galatAlvozWaSozaSca nistodaH SaNKayostaTA । svaropaDAtaSca BavetpratiSyAye'nilAtmake । uzRaH sapItakaH snAvo GrARAt sravati pEttike । kfSo'tipARquH santapto BavettfzRABipIqitaH । saDUmaM sahasA vahniM vamatIva ca mAnavaH । kaPaH kaPakfte GrARAcCuklaH SItaH sravenmuhuH । SuklAvaBAsaH SUnAkzo BavedvuruSiromuKaH । SirogalOzWatAlUnAM kaRqUyanamatIva ca । BUtvA BUtvA pratiSyAyo yo'kasmAdvinivarttate । sampakvo vApyapakvo vA sa sarvapraBavaH smftaH । liNgAni cEva sarvezAM pInasAnAM ca sarvaje । raktaje tu pratiSyAye raktAsrAvaH pravarttate । tAmrAkzaSca Bavejjantu ruroGAta pratIqitaH । durganDocCvAsavadanastaTA ganDAnna vetti ca । mUrcCanti cAtra kfmayaH SvetAH kfzRAstaTA'RavaH । kfmimUrdDavikAreRa samAnaM cAsya lakzaRam । praklidyati punarnAsA punaSca pariSuzyati । muhurAnahyate cApi muhurvivriyate taTA । niSvAsocCvAsadOrganDyaM taTA ganDAnnavetti ca । evaM duzwaM pratiSyAyaM jAnIyAtkfcCrasADanam । sarva eva pratiSyAyA narasyApratikAriRaH । kAlena rogajananA jAyante duzwapInasAH । bADiryyamAnDyamaGrARaM GorAMSca nayanAmayAn । kAmAgnisAdaSoPAMSca vfdDAH kurvanti pInasAH” ।

k.v: स्त्री रुग्रुजा चोपतापरोगव्याधिगदामयाः। क्षयः शोषश्च यक्ष्मा च प्रतिश्यायस्तु पीनसः॥

m: प्रति-˚श्यायिन् mfn. having a cold, Suśr.
